evidence.title: 《養吉齋叢錄》 on 澄懷園, called 翰林花園
evidence.excerpt_zh: 澄懷園在圓明園東南。康熙朝大學士索額圖賜園，鑾輅嘗臨幸焉，有聖祖御書制節謹度額。雍正三年，賜大學士張廷玉、朱軾，尚書蔡珽，翰林吳士玉、蔡世遠、勵宗萬、于振、戴瀚、楊炳九人居之，蓋皆直書房者。此兩書房詞臣得居之始，俗稱翰林花園。其稱澄懷者，則張文和於康熙間扈從塞上，蒙賜澄懷二大字，雍正五年揭以名其園也。後不戒於火，乾隆間給帑修葺，而山夾水檻已殊昔觀，惟近光樓至今巋然，上有聖祖御書青翠霄漢額。嘉慶壬戌，戶侍英公和直南書房，以樓將圮，鳩工繕完。樓東為麗景軒，又東有屋三楹，植紫藤二本，嘉慶辛酉朱文正直兩書房，治屋扶藤，顏曰古藤書屋。
evidence.summary: S01's 翰林花园 QC60 is 澄懷園, the garden of the court's Hanlin scholars, not part of Qichun Yuan; it fits the plan, where it lies outside the channel, and S220 puts it beside 绮春园's south-west. S01 draws no buildings, so it gives no form; 山夾 is an uncertain reading. Transcribed by eye.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 畅和堂
evidence.summary: South-west corner, by the Hanlin garden 澄怀园: from 1732 Ertai's 晚香园, then Yin Jishan's 寻春园, derelict after 1770, rebuilt 1813. Gate 松路花龛 of three bays, main hall five bays in two rolls with side halls 澄霞宇 and 开襟馆, and a square pavilion 森翠. West of its wall is the Hanlin garden 澄怀园.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
